query: What is Section 1 of BNS about?

gold_references.label: Section 1
gold_references.role: short title, commencement, and application of BNS

required_points: Section 1 gives the short title of the Act as the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
It states that every person shall be liable to punishment under this Sanhita for every act or omission guilty within India.

It extends application to offences committed by any citizen of India in any place outside India, any person on any ship or aircraft registered in India, and any person outside India targeting a computer resource in India.
optional_points: The section also states that nothing in this Sanhita shall affect provisions of any Act for punishing mutiny and desertion of officers, soldiers, sailors or airmen.

notes: Direct lookup. Retrieval should include Section 1.
